# SW2URDF 2026-09-13 Collision STL Update / 碰撞 STL 更新

> DRAFT / 发布准备：公开 Latest 发布仍待第三方源码/声明材料、干净 Windows 运行时及同一候选包的实机验收。本页不表示这些检查已通过。
> Public Latest publication is pending third-party source/notices, clean-Windows runtime verification, and native acceptance of this exact candidate. This draft does not claim those checks passed.

## English

### Changes since v20260906

- **All eight collision strategies use mesh references in the normal STL export path.** Box, cylinder and sphere approximations now produce collision STL files. Component bounding boxes are combined into one STL per Link instead of expanding into many URDF collision elements. Visual copy, simplified mesh, accurate mesh and convex hull retain their mesh-based paths.
- Generated primitive positions and orientations are baked into Link-local STL vertices; their URDF mesh origin is zero to avoid applying the transform twice. Reports identify the actual mesh URI and geometry type.
- **Recover historical export configurations:** support legacy XML and shared Link formats, including XML strings declaring UTF-16. Migrate Link/Joint identities, topology, component bindings, reference geometry and applicable joint settings. Recompute derived poses/inertia/mesh data from the current assembly; retain the original configuration. Review migrated references before saving.
- **Read mass properties across component configurations.** Temporarily align the loaded document configuration for metadata reads, then restore it and rebuild; occurrence references remain unchanged. This addresses the mixed-configuration export failure after migration.
- Reduce STL triangle counts in a separate worker with shape protection, caching and time limits. The percentage is a requested removal target, not a guaranteed file-size reduction. Show measured before/after sizes; preserve the original mesh when no smaller valid result is available. Mass, COM and inertia are unchanged by mesh reduction.
- Add shared simulation intent with separate OpenUSD/MuJoCo gains, direct measured-mass calibration, and MJCF drive checks before mesh generation. Preserve model metadata, output selections and the configured output name; provide editable license presets and clearer progress/warning reports.

### Verification and limits

- This draft reuses the unchanged installer built on 2026-09-11 from the source commit below. Release-note preparation does not rebuild the binary.
- Its official build log records **1,195 plugin tests, 134 Core tests and 9 MuJoCo integration tests passed**, with no failed/skipped tests in those suites. Bundled OpenUSD, mesh-reduction smoke/protocol and MuJoCo gates passed.
- Collision regression covers generated primitive transforms, fallback origins and ROS1/ROS2 package references. A 500-box example generates 6,000 triangles and one collision mesh reference per tested Link; packaged assets match their source bytes.
- Prior native SolidWorks 2023 checks of predecessor `6d6ee3c` covered migration/save/reopen and mixed-configuration export. They do **not** establish native acceptance of this `a0af2c5` installer. This candidate has not completed the full installation/upgrade/uninstall and native collision-export acceptance sequence.
- Cylinder/sphere meshes are tessellated approximations; a combined non-convex STL can behave differently from multiple native primitives in a simulator. Contact behavior needs target-simulator validation. This update does not establish the cause of a reported ROS TF issue, fix the unconfirmed SolidWorks 2025 issue #1, or include its dedicated diagnostic build.
- No blanket certification of all SolidWorks versions, ROS/Gazebo, Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, controllers or long simulations. Installer is unsigned. Back up assemblies, close SolidWorks before installation and review migrated bindings.
- Public distribution remains pending the [recorded release prerequisites](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/c1f2e659bb6d1bcb51fe478aa366c9d32c689c05/docs/reviews/2026-09-11-mesh-runtime-release-audit.md). Developer-machine runtime tests do not substitute for clean-Windows verification.

## 简体中文

### 相比 v20260906 的更新

- **正常 STL 导出路径中，全部八种碰撞策略均使用网格引用。** 箱体、圆柱、球体近似现在生成碰撞 STL；组件包围盒合并为每个 Link 一个 STL，避免在 URDF 中展开大量 collision 元素。复制可视网格、精简网格、精确网格和凸包继续使用各自的网格路径。
- 基本体的位置与轴向写入 Link-local STL 顶点，URDF 中对应网格原点归零，避免重复变换；报告同步记录实际网格 URI 和几何类型。
- **兼容历史导出配置：** 支持旧 XML 和共享 Link 格式，修复声明 UTF-16 的 XML 字符串解析失败。保留 Link/Joint 身份、拓扑、组件绑定、参考几何及适用的关节设置；位姿、惯性和网格等派生数据从当前装配体重新计算，原配置保留。保存前应核对迁移后的引用。
- **修复混合配置下的质量属性读取。** 读取元数据时临时对齐文档配置，随后恢复并重建；不改变组件实例的引用配置，解决迁移后因不同配置共存导致的导出失败。
- 独立进程执行 STL 减面，带形状保护、缓存和超时；比例表示目标移除量，不保证文件缩小比例。显示实测前后大小，没有更小的有效结果时保留原网格；减面不改变质量、质心或惯性。
- 增加公共仿真意图及分别设置的 OpenUSD/MuJoCo 增益、直接实测质量校准、生成网格前的 MJCF 驱动检查。修复模型信息、输出勾选和手动输出名称的保留；提供可编辑许可证选项及更明确的进度和警告报告。

### 验证范围与限制

- 本草稿沿用 2026-09-11 从下列源码提交构建的原安装包；本次编写说明不代表重新构建二进制。
- 官方构建日志记录：**1,195 项插件测试、134 项 Core 测试、9 项 MuJoCo 集成测试通过**，这些测试集均无失败或跳过；内置 OpenUSD、减面运行时/协议和 MuJoCo 检查通过。
- 碰撞回归覆盖基本体变换、失败回退原点和 ROS1/ROS2 包引用。500 个箱体生成 6,000 个三角形，测试 Link 使用一个碰撞网格引用，打包资产与源文件逐字节一致。
- 前序版本 `6d6ee3c` 已在 SolidWorks 2023 验证迁移、保存重开和混合配置导出；这**不等于**本次 `a0af2c5` 安装包已完成原生验收。本候选尚未完成完整安装/升级/卸载及原生碰撞导出的验收流程。
- 圆柱/球体 STL 是离散近似；合并的非凸网格与多个原生基本体可能有不同接触行为，需要在目标仿真器验证。未证实所报告 ROS TF 问题的原因；不宣称修复尚未确诊的 SolidWorks 2025 issue #1，也不包含其专用诊断版本。
- 不代表所有 SolidWorks 版本、ROS/Gazebo、Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab、控制器或长时间仿真均已验证。安装包未签名；安装前备份装配体并关闭 SolidWorks，迁移后核对绑定。
- 公开发布仍待[已记录的发布前提](https://github.com/osrbot/solidworks_urdf_exporter_pro/blob/c1f2e659bb6d1bcb51fe478aa366c9d32c689c05/docs/reviews/2026-09-11-mesh-runtime-release-audit.md)完成；开发机运行通过不能替代干净 Windows 验证。
